comparison.objective: Remove a tote from a high shelf after freeing its strap from a rake.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulate an entangled deformable strap, stabilize shelf objects, and lower a loaded tote without spilling.
comparison.success_condition: Tote rests released on the table, rake remains on shelf, and retained items determine full credit.
comparison.reason: Entanglement resolution and loaded-container handling do not test coaxial impact transfer, notch fracture, or small metal-fragment retrieval.
